title: Airbnb is threatening to launch an AI travel agent next year

claims.claim: Airbnb is developing a new kind of AI agent designed to serve as a travel agent.

evidence.quote: The company has revealed that it's developing a new kind of AI agent, which will be designed to serve as a travel agent of sorts

claims.claim: Airbnb revealed its plans for the AI agent in its letter for shareholders released with its Q3 2026 earnings.

evidence.quote: The company has revealed that it's developing a new kind of AI agent, which will be designed to serve as a travel agent of sorts, in its letter for shareholders that it released with its Q3 2026 earnings.

claims.claim: The company plans to start rolling out the new experience to users in the first half of 2027.

evidence.quote: It will start rolling out the new experience to users sometime in the first half of 2027.

claims.claim: Airbnb launched AI search and AI descriptions for listings a couple of months ago.

evidence.quote: Just a couple of months ago, it launched AI search, which lets you make inquiries using natural language, as well as AI descriptions for listings.
